title: 谷粒回仓
logline: 南方稻田大雨将至，稻农父女抢收稻谷，坚信谷粒入仓方能安心等雨，展现农耕人的朴实与靠谱储粮方案的价值。

shots.narrationZh: 乌云压了田埂，大雨今晚到
shots.narrationEn: Dark clouds press the field ridges, heavy rain will fall tonight.
shots.visual: A vast southern rice paddy with heavy golden rice ears swaying in the wind, dark clouds hanging low over distant misty mountains, muddy field ridges, sparrows flying across the sky, fine rain dots pattering on rice leaves.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉稳压声，语速稍缓，气息下沉重读「大雨今晚到」，带出天灾将至的紧绷感

shots.visual: Uncle Gui, a 59-year-old dark-skinned farmer with deep wrinkles, has an old army-green raincoat slung over his shoulder, rolled-up trouser legs stepping in mud, straw hat strap tight under his chin, touching a heavy drooping rice ear with his rough hand.

lines.zh: 收割机跑一遍，掉的谷够喂半年鸡
lines.en: The combine harvester leaves enough fallen grain to feed chickens for half a year.

shots.ttsDirection: 粗粝平实带乡土感，语速偏慢有顿挫，重读「谷粒」，带出老农对收成的执拗感

shots.visual: Qiuhe, a 26-year-old returning daughter with a ponytail and old baseball cap, long-sleeve shirt rolled to elbows, wearing labor protection gloves holding a rice bundle, rubber boots stepping in mud, looking up at the gloomy dark sky.

lines.zh: 爸，雨点子都砸脸了，别硬撑啊
lines.en: Dad, the rain drops are hitting my face, don't push yourself too hard.

shots.ttsDirection: 语气急恼带焦躁，语速稍快，重读「落雨」，带出女儿心疼收成又拗不过父亲的无奈感

shots.visual: Uncle Gui straightens his back, lifts the brim of his straw hat, showing a smile in his wrinkles, holding a handful of just-cut rice, dark clouds gathering thicker in the distance.

lines.zh: 谷粒全进仓，雨落我也不慌
lines.en: Once all the grain is in the barn, I won't panic even when the rain falls.

shots.ttsDirection: 疲惫沙哑带喘，语速偏缓有停顿，重读「来得及」，带出老农不服老的执拗感

shots.narrationEn: Grain returns to the barn, only then does the rain dare to fall.
shots.visual: Golden rice grains pour into a standardized sealed grain barn, Uncle Gui and Qiuhe stand beside the barn brushing grain chaff off their clothes and laughing, rain drops patter on the tiled roof outside, the grain barn brand logo fades in at the bottom of the screen.
shots.ttsDirection: 语气松缓带暖意，语速偏慢，重读「回仓」「敢落」，气息放轻带笑意，带出收成归仓的踏实欣慰感
